summary: JBT Marel Corp filed an 8-K/A to correct the effective date of a previously announced share repurchase program of up to $200 million of its common stock, moving the start from June 1, 2026, to May 18, 2026, through May 31, 2029. The board authorized the program at its discretion, subject to market conditions. The filing also notes a quarterly dividend of $0.10 per share payable June 9, 2026. No premium, advisors, or structural details were mentioned. Watch for execution pace and potential impact on share price, though no risk-arb angle exists as this is a standard capital return authorization.
